paragraphs: Abba bar Tachlifa; Rabbi Ze'ira, Chiyya son of Rabbi Bon, in Rabbi Hoshaya’s name (Jerusalem Talmud, Ma'aser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 7). Further there: Adda bar Tachlifa. See below, Acha b.T. and Rabbah b.T.; perhaps they are one.
